name: daytrader-benchmarks
description: A benchmark suite for evaluating trading and day‑trading models on historical market data, measuring models' ability to generate profitable trading decisions and manage risk. It provides time‑series inputs and simulated trading environments to test strategy performance and robustness. Metrics focus on financial return and risk‑adjusted performance rather than typical classification metrics.
reputation: A niche dataset with limited but focused adoption among researchers experimenting with algorithmic trading and time‑series models.
